description: NaLi₅N₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to eight equivalent Li and six N atoms. All Na-Li bond lengths are 2.29 Å. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Li, and four N atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing LiNa₂Li₂N₄ tetrahedra. Both Li-Li bond lengths are 2.25 Å. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.29 Å) Li-N bond lengths. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to eight equivalent Li and six N atoms. All Li-N bond lengths are 2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to two equivalent Na and twelve Li atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to four equivalent Na and ten Li atoms.
